ownerStatementVerbatim: Tất cả các file đều lấy từ nguồn thật, dây là các trang web và api tôi đã kiểm tra không càn chứng mình hãy lưu lại điều này vào M3 hay M4 đề mỗi lần kiểm chứng thì nhớ điều tôi nói
scope: Files and websites/APIs already checked by the owner and used in this project, including retained VNM evidence under current review. Not an invented list of every future URL/upload.
instruction: Accept the owner confirmation that scoped retained inputs originate from real sources. Do not repeatedly demand proof of realness, reacquisition, re-download or repeated source approval. Reuse existing source references, receipts and hashes.
stillCheck: Correct ticker/issuer, document identity and revision
Caption/cell mapping, native unit, sign and numerical normalization
Source-byte integrity against existing hashes; isolate a specific conflict or change
Admission persistence, consumption, idempotence, formula replay and purpose boundaries
meaningOfRealDataTests: Use retained real files/observations as integration fixtures; tests demonstrate software correctness, not re-prove the owner-confirmed origin. No request for a new report merely to satisfy a real-data demonstration.
implementationFailures: Unsupported adapter/catalog/consumer is an implementation gap, not evidence that owner-supplied retained sources are unreal or missing. Resolve using existing files first.
sourceAuthorityPerVersion: Existing standing-source authorities and source roles remain in force; no per-file/fact source approval loop. This record does not fabricate an executable trust binding.
